text: This report provides information and identifies a preliminary set of issues regarding the revised application located at 240 and 242 Finch Avenue West. Staff are currently reviewing the application. It has been circulated to all appropriate agencies and City divisions for comment. Staff will proceed to schedule a community consultation meeting for the application with the Ward Councillor.
North York Community Council: 1. Deferred consideration of the item until its next meeting on April 24, 2019.
